title: Files UX: a refused file type shows 「您没有权限保存这条记录」, a duplicate value shows an English generic message, and the upload-link page is English-only and names no record
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible).
reach: public entries — the console record form and the upload-link page in a browser (Playwright, zh-CN), measured once each on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).

## Business reason

An employee filing an expense line with an e-invoice gets told they lack permission when the real problem is the file type, and gets an English sentence naming no field when the invoice number is a duplicate. Both send them to an administrator for nothing.

## What happens

1. **File type refused → permission message.** File field `invoice_file` with `accept: ['.pdf','.ofd','.png','.jpg','.jpeg']`. Picking `not-an-invoice.txt` is accepted by the widget (no hint), and 创建 answers `POST /api/v1/data/k7en_claim_line` → `400 {"error":"File type 'text/plain' is not permitted by the accept list declared for 'invoice_file' (.pdf, .ofd, .png, .jpg, .jpeg)","code":"ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT"}`. The form shows 「您没有权限保存这条记录。」.
2. **Unique violation → generic English.** A unique index on `invoice_no` (`unique: 'organization'`); a duplicate number shows 「A record with this value already exists」 at the top of the zh-CN form, naming no field (server log: `UNIQUE constraint failed: k7en_claim_line.organization_id, k7en_claim_line.invoice_no`).
3. **Upload-link page.** The page `create_upload_link` hands out (`/api/v1/storage/upload-links/…`) reads only English ("Upload a file / A file was asked for, to be put in a file field of a record … / File / Send / Done. The file was attached; you can close this page.") in a zh-CN deployment, and does not say which record or field the file goes to.

## Expected

(1) `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` shows the server's own reason on the file field, and the widget warns on a type outside `accept`. (2) A unique violation names the field (「发票号码已存在」). (3) The upload page is localized and names the record and field.

Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` seat (form error mapping in `ui/apps/console`) and the storage seat for the upload-link page.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` → 15 hits (#23932 REST declared client refusal, #21730 500 on accept refusal, both closed — server side, fixed); `upload link page` → 130 hits (#30892 closed, the MCP file tools), none on the console mapping or the page copy.
